name: @ank1015/llm-desktop-app
description: Private Electron desktop app for the embedded LLM server and frontend shell

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ank1015/llm-core build && pnpm --filter @ank1015/llm-sdk build && pnpm --filter @ank1015/llm-agents build && pnpm --filter @ank1015/llm-server build && pnpm --filter @ank1015/llm-web-app build && node ../../scripts/remove-paths.mjs dist release vendor --tsbuildinfo && tsc && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs && node scripts/assemble-web.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-package.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --projectDir .package --dir --config.directories.output=../release
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-package.mjs && electron-builder --projectDir .package --config.directories.output=../release
scripts.test: echo "No tests configured for desktop app yet"
scripts.test:unit: echo "No unit tests configured for desktop app yet"
